name: ask-on-auto-deny
description: When auto mode's classifier blocks a tool call, asks you above the prompt and lets you allow that exact call once

ttlMinutes.title: Allowance minutes
ttlMinutes.description: How long an Allow once stays usable before it expires

maxPending.title: Pending shown
maxPending.description: How many blocked calls the band above the prompt lists at once

autoSubmit.title: Submit the retry prompt
autoSubmit.description: After you allow a call, send the model a prompt to retry it; off puts the prompt in the prompt box for you to send

askDialog.title: Also ask in a dialog
askDialog.description: Also open Claude Code's question dialog (Allow once / Refuse) when auto mode blocks a call
